final_root_contracts.common_i11:
theorem common_i11 {n j : ℕ} (hij : 11 < j) (hjn : j ≤ n / 2) :
    Common n 11 j
final_root_contracts.original_i11_gcd:
theorem original_i11_gcd :
    ∀ n j : ℕ, 1 ≤ 11 ∧ 11 < j ∧ j ≤ n / 2 →
      ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ 11 ≤ p ∧ p ∣ Nat.gcd (Nat.choose n 11) (Nat.choose n j)
final_root_contracts.original_i11:
theorem original_i11 :
    ∀ n j : ℕ, 1 ≤ 11 ∧ 11 < j ∧ j ≤ n / 2 →
      ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ 11 ≤ p ∧ p ∣ Nat.choose n 11 ∧ p ∣ Nat.choose n j
